audit_items.proof_trace: The small-position bypass fires only at line 1006 via `if (debt_value <= liquidation_params.close_factor_bypass_min_value) { return }`, where `debt_value = coin_value(price, debt_balance, decimals).ceil()` is a u64 in whole-USD units and `close_factor_bypass_min_value` is a u64 from market config in the same unit. Because `ceil(x) <= n` (integer n) implies `x <= n`, the actual USD debt value is always within the threshold when the bypass triggers. All three liquidation entry points pass `close_factor_bypass_min_value` from `market_config()` to `LiquidationParams`, so no call path skips this guard.
